name: Boeing 707-320B
summary: The airliner that opened the jet age for most of the world: four engines on pylons under a 35-degree swept wing.

verify.note: The FlightGear model measures 45.56 m long, 42.02 m across and 12.05 m tall, smaller than the published 707-320B (46.61, 44.42 and 12.93 m) and between the -120 and -320 sizes.
